title: Bilal's Unshakeable Stand
paragraphs: Bilal bin Rabah menghadapi tekanan berat agar meninggalkan keyakinannya, namun ia dengan tenang mengulang satu kata sederhana yang sama berulang kali, menolak untuk menyerah meski situasinya sangat sulit. Ketenangannya di bawah tekanan menjadi terkenal luas, dan ia akhirnya dibebaskan lalu menjadi orang yang mengumandangkan adzan, panggilan shalat, dalam komunitas Muslim awal.

Mereka yang menyaksikan ujiannya kemudian menggambarkan bagaimana suaranya tidak pernah bergetar karena takut, hanya karena kelelahan, dan bagaimana pengulangannya yang tenang justru tampak lebih menggoyahkan mereka yang menekannya daripada argumen apa pun. Orang-orang yang menghadapi tekanan sulit di tempat kerja atau kehidupan kadang mengingat kisah Bilal untuk memberi semangat. Kisah ini menunjukkan bahwa keteguhan yang tenang bisa bertahan bahkan melewati keadaan yang paling berat sekalipun.
answerKey: Bilal ibn Rabah faced severe pressure to abandon his beliefs, yet he calmly repeated the same simple word again and again, refusing to give in despite the extreme difficulty of his situation. His steady composure under pressure became widely known, and he was eventually freed and went on to become the person who called the adhan, the call to prayer, in the early Muslim community. Those who witnessed his ordeal later described how his voice never wavered with fear, only with exhaustion, and how his calm repetition seemed to unsettle those trying to pressure him more than any argument could have. People who face difficult pressure at work or in life sometimes remember Bilal's story for encouragement. It shows that quiet, steady conviction can outlast even the harshest circumstances a person might face.
